name: Nullweave Diplomatic Formal Jacket
description:
Vantablack's diplomatic textile division produces garments for inter-corponation liaisons, city council neutral-zone sessions, and cross-faction negotiators who need to enter rooms where faction signals — colors, corporate insignia, augment displays, geneware aesthetics — can poison an opening handshake. The Nullweave jacket is constructed from a matte, signal-neutral fabric that absorbs rather than reflects light, carrying no embedded RFID, no smart-thread, no BCI-reactive elements. It is deliberately, architecturally empty of information. The cut is neither masculine nor feminine, neither conservative nor progressive — a silhouette that was designed by committee to land nowhere on any cultural register.

The jacket accommodates a full range of augment hardware and geneware modifications through a flexible internal structure that adjusts without visible seaming. It comes in three colors: Meridian Gray, Void Black, and Pale Neutral — each chosen via spectral analysis to be maximally unassociated with any corponation palette. Wearing one signals that you are here to negotiate, not to represent. In the right rooms, this is more powerful than any insignia.
cultural_context: The Nullweave jacket is required attire at several categories of inter-corponation meeting under GLMZ's Corporate Coexistence Accords. Its restricted status comes not from danger but from regulatory control — only licensed diplomatic personnel and certified neutral-zone mediators are officially permitted to purchase it. Gray market examples circulate among fixers and independent negotiators who work outside corponation structures.
story_hooks: A gray-market Nullweave jacket is traced back to a Vantablack internal leak — someone is selling diplomatic-grade signal-null garments to parties who should not have access to them.
A character wears a genuine Nullweave to a meeting they are not authorized to attend; the jacket gets them through the door, but being recognized in it raises questions about who certified them.
The jacket's signal-null properties inadvertently block a passive BCI medical alert — and a negotiator in the room has an undetected cardiac augment that needs external monitoring.
related_entities: Vantablack Media Spectral Barrier Display System

physical_description.visual_profile: A precisely tailored, geometrically neutral jacket that seems to absorb rather than reflect the eye. The silhouette is deliberately androgynous — shoulders neither broad nor narrow, chest neither emphasized nor hidden, length hitting mid-hip with mathematical precision. The fabric appears almost textured in its flatness, a matte void that makes the wearer seem subtly depthless. When worn, the jacket creates an impression of deliberate erasure; it makes the person inside feel less like a statement and more like a vessel.
physical_description.fit: Perfectly tailored but not restrictive; seams are invisible or nearly so. The internal structure is engineered to shift and breathe around augment hardware — chrome limbs, subdermal plates, neural interfaces — without puckering, bunching, or creating telltale bulges. Sits close enough to suggest precision, loose enough to suggest non-alignment.
physical_description.primary_material: Vantablack-infused synthetic composite weave (classified as Nullweave™) — a light-absorbing fabric engineered to minimize reflectance and electromagnetic signature. Feels smooth to the touch but with a slight grip, almost tactile without being rough.
physical_description.texture: Matte, light-absorbing surface with a barely perceptible micro-nap. Runs cool against skin. Zero sheen, no visible pattern — the texture exists only at the microscopic scale as an intentional diffusion matrix.
physical_description.color_scheme: Available in three officially neutral tones: Meridian Gray (warm-neutral, spectral middle), Void Black (maximum light absorption, no undertone), Pale Neutral (cool gray approaching white, designed for contrast-minimization in bright spaces). No patterns, no accent colors, no branding visible.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap closure (concealed beneath the front flap to leave the chest completely unreadable). The snaps are shielded to prevent RFID leakage. Alternative friction-fit versions exist for high-security negotiations.
distinctive_features: Invisible internal rigging system that accommodates augment hardware without visible seaming or stress points
RFID-shielded construction — no embedded smart-thread, no BCI-reactive elements, no networked fabric
Perfectly symmetrical front panels with no decorative stitching or topstitching visible
Shoulder yoke engineered to sit naturally on cybernetic and biological shoulders equally
Internal liner treated to suppress thermal signatures on imaging scans
Tag-free construction — manufacturer label is printed directly onto interior seam in gray-on-gray
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 (officially restricted). The price point and licensing exclusivity place it at upper Tier 3 to lower Tier 2, but gray-market versions are accessible to Tier 4 operators. The jacket itself signals neither wealth nor poverty — that is its entire function.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearing this jacket declares neutrality, professional negotiation, and regulatory compliance. It is the uniform of people who enter rooms where faction signals can derail agreement. Signals diplomatic authority without representing any faction. In gray-market contexts, it marks the wearer as someone skilled enough to navigate inter-corponation spaces or trusted by entities who operate outside standard hierarchies.
physical_description.condition_typical: Always pristine. The light-absorbing fabric shows no dust, no wrinkles, no wear patterns — or rather, wear does not register visually on the surface. Wearer maintains it obsessively because any visible degradation becomes a statement in a garment designed to avoid statements.
